rationale_bullets: The 2024 title QB left (Leavitt 76.4/310, injury-shortened -> LSU as the cycle's top transfer); the replacement room is credible but unproven above-average: Boley (former 4*, 10 P4 starts as RS-Fr, #12 SEC QB Rating, 59.4 PFF/387, 12 INT w/ OC-attributed context).

key_players.name: Cutter Boley
key_players.evidence: 10 starts at Kentucky as RS-Fr; 65%, 12 INT; PFF 59.4/387

data_gaps: No spring depth chart at QB2

rationale_bullets: The workhorse left with 4* grades (Raleek Brown 80.7/265, 1,141 @ 6.1 -> Texas); Udoh followed (Liberty).
Returns are quality-flash, volume-thin: Kyson Brown (74.4 on 35 snaps, 2025 opening-day starter back from season-ending injury), Jason Brown Jr. (72.9/20, 134-yd Sun Bowl).
Adds are FCS: Gillis (Top-10 FCS back, 1,200 @ 6.5) + Avit (short-yardage). Athlon calls it 'deep and talented'; no returning FBS volume.
45 = fringe-below-average: committee of unproven-at-volume pieces behind a rebuilt line.
The 8th-pctile as-played number is an artifact of Tyson's in-and-out injury year (82.9/300, drafted #8 overall) + McClain's 53.6 on 458 routes (expired).

The reload is the nation's top-ranked WR transfer class (Athlon): Omarion Miller (Colorado MVP, All-B12, 67.9/313), Reed Harris (BC, 65.6/477), Vines-Bright (UW, 63.4/271) - 'all three look like future NFL Draft picks' (attributed).
Returning glue: Moss (60.3/184 slot), Eusebio (All-B12 HM, 57.4/265); TE = former-4* pedigree (Anderson/Ia), zero production.
56 = above average: three verified P4 tapes + depth, capped by zero returning chemistry with a new QB and an unproven TE room.

key_players.name: Omarion Miller
key_players.evidence: All-B12 at Colorado, team MVP; PFF 67.9/313

rationale_bullets: Total rebuild: ALL FIVE 2025 starters gone (Iheanachor 72.5/860 -> NFL R1; Scott/Obigbo/Coleman expired; Atkins -> Missouri) from a unit that played at just the 42nd pctile WITH them.
The verified incoming tape is modest: Alo-Tupuola (GT starter, 57.1/455 - repair add) at C, Baklenko (2-yr Stanford starter, 67.9/155 at OU) at RT; best returning grade is Stewart's 70.6 on 260.
LT is a yr-1 (Westbrooks) vs a no-tape JUCO (#1 overall prospect Mitchell, feed-missed); Helton moves C->LG off a 53.0.
P6's attributed doubt: 'a third-straight Top 40 finish in OL Run Push is in question.' 36 = bottom-third with a credible-pedigree path out.

The defense's star returns: Fite (68.5/587), an all-conference-candidate NT who turned down an early NFL bid, plus Clayton Smith (65.8/469) on a P6-verified eligibility-appeal year and yr-2 starter Gardner.
The exits took the top grade (Wodtly 77.6/467) and three more rotation pieces (O'Neal, Dorbah, Kongaika).
Restock is P4-starter tape, not projection: Thompson (MSU, 68.2/420) + Winston (Baylor, 65.9/586), plus 4* 'spring hero' Hugo; Athlon: 'should again be very stout.'
51 = average-plus: a star, an 8-man credible rotation, no elite edge.
Both 2nd-team All-B12 tacklers graduated (Crook 82.4/733, Elliott 67.5/649 - 199 combined tackles, 1-2 on the team) from a 77th-pctile room.

The replacement is the FBS' leading tackler: Long (CSU, 1st-tm All-MW, 4* transfer grades, 71.0/770) - P6: makes this 'a reload instead of a rebuild'; Hughes rises off 400 partial-starter snaps; Fiaseu (Athlon-explicit 6th year) is 'starter-level.'
LB caution rule applied: Long is a volume tackler, but grade and production AGREE (71.0 on 770).
50 = average: real starter replacement + experienced depth, minus an 82.4 alpha.
